page.title: Ancient Stones
page.subtitle: Keeper of the Ancient rune.
page.heroDescription: With a decidedly storybook aesthetic and super unique detailing like the columns framing of the sidepanels and the cell shaded stonework on the top and front, this PC really feels like an homage to the more artsy, playful side of gaming. The jewel-esque Ironside stone on the front is made from laser cut acrylic and adds gorgeous depth to the PC’s 2D design, while the right side panel artwork is an optical illusion that makes the PC appear to be housing a single glowing rune.
page.about: We wanted a PC that couldn’t help but be noticed; more of a centerpiece than an accent.

embed.title: Introducing our new Limited Edition PC: Ancient Stones

content.title: Journey Back in Time
content.description: ‘Ancient Stones’ was carefully designed to appear as if it was plucked straight out of a storybook. From the illustrated stonework, to the grand pillars that frame each side, to the nostalgic cell shaded art style; each detail describes a story withered by time but still flowing with life.

content.title: Keeper of the Ancient Rune
content.description: Each PC is adorned with a large rune, aglow on the side panel, appearing to live inside the PCs rocky, protective shell.

content.title: Happy MAR10 Day!
content.description: We’re celebrating MAR10 Day with two new retro colorways inspired by the iconic games we’ve all grown to love.

items.title: Proven Performance
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

items.title: Backed by Warranty
items.description: We stand behind our gaming computers with an unrivaled, 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty at no additional charge.

items.title: Shipped with Care
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully packaged to arrive safely at your door. We use double boxing and custom internal packaging to keep components secure during transit, so your system arrives exactly as intended.

items.title: Built by Family. Powered by Passion.
items.description: We’re more than a gaming PC company. We’re a family. Founded by four siblings, Ironside has always been a personal project, built with love, care, and respect for craftsmanship. What started in a Las Vegas garage is now a company still run with the same hands-on spirit and attention to detail.
